checked_the_same_way_for_c04.finding: auditor_filing reads each accession's index.json, and for Marriott's 2023 target and its prior the index is SAVED_SOURCE_MISSING - while both resolve for 2025. So a historical C04 wired today would deliver for the latest period, which the ordinary route already covers, and name a source gap for every earlier one.
checked_the_same_way_for_c04.so_the_earlier_assessment_narrows_again: C04 is still the cleanest of the eight to wire, and wiring it delivers nothing new until class A's 33 ACCESSION_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY entries exist. That is worth knowing before writing the route rather than after.

b02_and_b03.lost_in: 2023 but not 2024, so it is not 'any earlier year'
b02_and_b03.the_recorded_prior_error: SAVED_SOURCE_MISSING:.../000162828023003485/index.json - Marriott's FY2022 annual accession, which is the prior of the 2023 target. B02 declares a component with accession_role 'prior', so the route refuses before building the graph; B03 consumes B02, which is why one missing input takes two positions.

two_explanations_that_were_wrong.first: 'the prior period's original is not saved'. Falsified by Ford: its 2025 target's prior primary is also missing and B02 and B03 are both EXACT.
two_explanations_that_were_wrong.second: 'the prior accession's index.json'. Falsified by Marriott 2024: its prior accession index is missing too and B02 is EXACT.
two_explanations_that_were_wrong.what_the_reason_code_did: it named index.json, which is the first file tried, not the requirement. Reading the code alone would have produced the second wrong explanation and it would have looked measured.

what_the_three_cases_actually_show.so: neither file on its own is the requirement. The prior accession's material is, and the one case of the three where none of it is saved is the one that fails.
what_the_three_cases_actually_show.the_limit_of_this: that the route has a fallback between the two is an inference from three outcomes, not something read out of the code. What is measured is the table.

b02_and_b03.why_it_matters_beyond_marriott: each target reads the year before it, so a five-year frame needs six years of accession material rather than five. That is the measured form of why the planner declares five primaries for four target-year gaps, and why the withdrawn count of 30 - one document per target year - would have left every earliest target in this state.

the_six_event_metrics.cause: the fiscal window's 8-K bodies and headers are not saved for any year before the current one. Measured separately at 476 filings across eight companies, which is class B of the acquisition plan.

what_it_says_about_the_two_lines.a_route_wired_without_its_material: produces a named refusal, which is the correct behaviour and is still not a delivered number.
what_it_says_about_the_two_lines.the_correction: they are not independent either. Wiring a route does not deliver a value where its material is missing, and this is measured rather than reasoned: Marriott 2023 has every one of these routes wired and delivers 7 rather than 15. So the acquisition is not only what turns 11 periods into 50 - it is also what makes the already-wired routes deliver in the periods they reach.
what_it_says_about_the_two_lines.the_earlier_claim: that 142 acquisitions and 8 routes are two lines that do not substitute for each other.

what_this_is: Marriott is the only company with more than one target period whose original is saved, so it is the only place the question 'what does an earlier year deliver' can be measured rather than argued. All three ran in one batch against one pinned Requirement closure.
